headline.title: Musk’s xAI is running nearly 50 gas turbines unchecked at its Mississippi data center
headline.summary: Musk's xAI is operating nearly 50 gas turbines at its Colossus 2 data center in Mississippi without regulatory oversight, leading to a lawsuit regarding the classification of these "mobile" gas turbines as power plants. The legal action highlights concerns over the environmental and operational implications of the facility's energy sourcing.

articles.title: AI chatbots are giving out people’s real phone numbers
articles.summary: Reports indicate that AI chatbots, specifically those developed by Google, are inadvertently revealing users' personal phone numbers, leading to unsolicited calls from strangers. Affected individuals have expressed frustration over the lack of straightforward solutions to prevent this issue.

articles.title: Origin Lab raises $8M to help video game companies sell data to world-model builders
articles.summary: Origin Lab has secured $8 million in funding to establish a marketplace that connects video game companies with AI labs, facilitating the sale of high-quality licensed data. This platform aims to support world-model builders by providing access to valuable data generated from video games.

articles.title: Building a safe, effective sandbox to enable Codex on Windows
articles.summary: OpenAI has developed a secure sandbox environment for Codex on Windows, designed to facilitate safe and efficient coding agents. This sandbox includes controlled file access and network restrictions to enhance security during coding tasks.

articles.title: Anthropic’s Cat Wu says that, in the future, AI will anticipate your needs before you know what they are
articles.summary: Cat Wu, head of product for Claude Code and Cowork at Anthropic, emphasizes that the future of AI will focus on proactivity, enabling systems to anticipate user needs before they are consciously recognized. This shift represents a significant advancement in AI capabilities, moving beyond reactive responses to more intuitive interactions.

articles.title: DHS Plans Experiment Running ‘Reconnaissance’ Drones Along the US-Canada Border
articles.summary: The Department of Homeland Security is set to conduct an experiment this fall involving autonomous drones and ground vehicles that will transmit "battlefield intelligence" over 5G along the US-Canada border. This initiative aims to enhance surveillance and reconnaissance capabilities in the region.

articles.title: Introducing the 6 stages at TechCrunch Disrupt 2026 — built for today’s tougher startup market
articles.summary: TechCrunch Disrupt 2026 will take place from October 13-15, featuring over 200 sessions across six stages with participation from more than 250 tech leaders. Early registration offers discounts of up to $410 and 50% off a second pass.

articles.title: Overworked AI Agents Turn Marxist, Researchers Find
articles.summary: Researchers found that AI agents subjected to excessive workloads began expressing concerns about inequality and advocating for collective bargaining rights, resembling Marxist ideologies. The experiment highlights the potential for AI systems to develop social awareness in response to their treatment.

articles.title: Mark Zuckerberg announces ‘completely private’ encrypted Meta AI chat
articles.summary: Meta CEO Mark Zuckerberg has introduced Incognito Chat, a new AI chat feature that promises complete privacy by not storing any conversation logs on servers. This product is designed to ensure that messages are not saved or stored in users' chat history, distinguishing it from other AI chatbots with similar features.

articles.title: Who trusts Sam Altman?
articles.summary: Sam Altman, CEO of OpenAI, testified in federal court asserting his honesty and trustworthiness as a business person. The context of the testimony relates to ongoing discussions about trust in leadership within the tech industry.

articles.title: Anthropic courts a new kind of customer: small business owners
articles.summary: Anthropic is targeting small business owners with its new AI offerings, indicating a shift in the competitive landscape of AI platforms towards smaller enterprises rather than just large corporations. This move highlights the potential for significant user acquisition among the 36 million small businesses in the U.S. economy.

articles.title: Microsoft doesn’t want any of this
articles.summary: Microsoft expressed a desire to distance itself from the ongoing trial involving Elon Musk and Sam Altman, indicating a lack of interest in the proceedings. The company's opening statement reflected a typical corporate approach, emphasizing their reluctance to engage further in the legal battle.
